$comment: ⚠️ IMPLEMENTATION-PRIVATE EMITTED IR ONLY. This schema validates the compatibility shape that `compileLumenFormulaLanguage` currently emits. It is not a published language contract, public semantic source, hand-authoring/conversion target, or downstream orchestration API. CANONICAL PUBLIC SEMANTIC SOURCE: the edition-pinned source pack, mechanically projected to `docs/spec/generated/public-ir.lumen`. `docs/spec/ir.lumen` owns residual public interchange plus private emitted/runtime support structures. Historical emitted-only kinds in this schema do not select public source forms. Private shape changes require internal migration and regenerated evidence where applicable, not downstream language-consumer notification.
title: Private emitted Lumen IR compatibility shape (lumen.ir 0.2.5)
description: Internal validation fixture for emitted compiler output; non-normative as an authoring, public-semantic, or downstream interchange target. The canonical intended language is the public source pack plus its checked docs/spec/generated/public-ir.lumen projection. This schema describes contract.version 0.2.5 of the current private compatibility output. The version pins one implementation shape for migration/regression purposes, not the language-release label or a public promise. Private shape changes require an explicit internal migration/version decision and regenerated goldens where applicable. Historical/private kinds remain compatibility facts, not selected public constructors.

metadata.description: Descriptive declaration-layer metadata bag (ir.lumen `Metadata`). Non-semantic provenance/description data attached to a declaration-layer shape; it does not affect typechecking, scheduling, or runtime behavior. `title` and `description` are single-valued descriptive strings; the open `...: [string]` catch-all collects additional descriptive keys (e.g. `normative`, `review-note`, `review-todo`) into string lists in source order. Semantic authored keys (`form-id`, `manifest-check`, `form-status`, `syntax-*`, `lowers-*`, `body-field`, `self`) are NOT metadata and do not appear here; the `propertyNames` guard rejects those exact names and the `syntax-*`/`lowers-*` prefixes (and the reserved `origin` key) so a semantic key can never leak into the bag. `origin` is a sibling, not folded in. Replaces the pre-0.2.3 `description` field on declaration-layer shapes.

kind.description: Closed set of node kinds in the implementation-private emitted 0.2.5 compatibility shape. This is not the accepted source surface, public semantic constructor catalog, or downstream contract; those are defined by the public source pack and projected to `generated/public-ir.lumen`. A new emitted node kind requires an internal schema/migration decision and regenerated evidence, not a public language-contract bump. The gate validates top-level nodes and recursion-gates nested nodes by signature. Most per-kind payloads remain descriptively open; the `run` payload is the principal closed exception. Historical/private lowering kinds such as `do`, `settle`, `for-each`, `scatter`, and `gather` remain here only because this compatibility lane describes what the current implementation can emit or validate. Their presence does not select or restore retired source forms. There is no emitted `reduce` node kind; current implementation compatibility represents collection reduction structurally on a map node.

runNode.description: Emitted node for the public `run` step (replaces the prior `apply` node-kind name). Closed payload: invokes `target` (by-name | by-ref) against a top-level `environment` record (formerly apply.input), with optional ambient `with` association and a `runInput` block carrying runEventSink/nudge/runMetadata/detached. `outcome` is `transparent` (the target's outcome flows through) EXCEPT for a detached run (`runInput.detached: true`), which evaluates to a RunHandle and so emits `outcome: "handle"`.

runTarget.description: What a `run` invokes — an extensible DU. `by-name` carries a resolved formula `name`; `by-ref` carries an `Expression` `ref` (e.g. a quote/handle value). Arbitrary-step targets slot in additively in a later release.

runInput.description: The run step's own configuration — distinct from the target's `environment`. `runEventSink` is a resolved channel ref/facet for child run events; `nudge` requests an agent/session nudge after dispatch; `runMetadata` augments the resulting RunHandle's persistent record; `detached` (S4) mints a host-adopted top-level run (non-blocking, evaluates to a RunHandle, not drained at the spawner boundary; degrades to owned at a bare/terminal host).
